How HGA works on uCollect.

See your card. See the process. See the proof.

01 / RECEIVE ITChecked in and documented

Once your card arrives at HGA it's checked in and documented. Your guaranteed delivery to reveal clock starts the moment the carrier delivers it.

02 / INSPECT ITInspected, scanned, identified

Your card is carefully inspected, scanned and identified before grading, so its condition and identity are documented from the start.

03 / GRADE ITSoftware assisted, human graded

HGA's advanced grading software helps evaluate your card against standardized criteria, with grading details, included subgrades and a full grading report explaining your final grade.

04 / PROTECT ITSealed and chipped

Your graded card is secured inside your selected Poly or premium Glass and Metal housing, complete with an RFID chip and digital verification.

05 / REVEAL ITWithin 15 business days, guaranteed

See your final grade, subgrades and grading report through your uCollect portal.

Why the process is a photo rail Transparency has to be shown, not described. Each step gets an image of what the collector will actually see in uCollect. Mobile users swipe; desktop users get arrows.

Know everything.

  1. Blind grading for greater objectivity

    HGA separates centering and grading into distinct steps, while keeping graders unaware of whose card they're evaluating. The focus stays on the card, not its owner.

  2. Guaranteed delivery to reveal clock

    Know exactly when your grade is due, backed by HGA's 15 business day "no excuses" guarantee.

  3. Software assisted grading

    Software assisted technology helps evaluate your card against consistent grading criteria for a more standardized, data driven result.

  4. Autograph grading included

    Submitting a signed card? Get an autograph grade where applicable without paying for an additional add on.

  5. RFID verification and blockchain certification

    Tap your card's label with your phone to access its permanent digital record. Each card is blockchain certified, an additional layer of protection against card swapping and fraudulent verification.

  6. No card value upcharge under $10,000

    Pay the same grading price on cards valued under $10,000, without surprise value based fees. Above $10,000, a 2% insurance and handling upcharge applies.

Get more.

    From standard trading cards to oversized collectibles and unique booklet formats, HGA accommodates over 60 different card sizes, including industry first sizes like booklets. And if we don't have a size that fits your card, we'll create one that does.

  3. Special edition launch label

    Mark your card as part of HGA's relaunch with an exclusive launch edition label.

  5. Club U benefits

  6. Earn the exclusive HGA Flawless Gold Label

Questions

Before you join.

All 48 answers
What is a pre-launch slot?

Prepaid grading for one card at the 15 business day tier, in the housing you choose, at pre-launch pricing. Your slots live on your account. Up to 100 per housing per order, with no limit on orders.

When can I send my cards?

HGA officially reopens February 1, 2027. From then, reserve a grading day up to a year ahead and ship your cards to arrive that day. The 15 business day clock starts at carrier delivery.

What is Glass Box Grading™?

HGA's new grading experience: software assisted grading, card tracking, detailed grading reasons, digital verification and a guaranteed turnaround, all visible to you through uCollect.

What can I send?

Any sports card or TCG card, any size. HGA Poly has a case for every size on the market, vintage to booklets, and if yours doesn't exist yet, we make it. HGA Glass is offered for every size too.

What about cards worth over $10,000?

There is no card value upcharge under $10,000. For cards valued above $10,000, a 2% insurance and handling upcharge applies, paid when you reserve. The slot still covers the grade.

Can I transfer or gift a pre-launch slot?

No. Pre-launch purchases are tied to the purchasing account and cannot be transferred.

Can I get a refund?

All sales are final, and pre-launch purchases cannot be transferred.

Why these questions The FAQ answers the objections the meeting raised in the order collectors raise them: what am I buying, when can I ship, what if my card is worth more than $10k, can I transfer it. The non transferable rule from Trevor is stated plainly rather than buried in terms. The FAQ sits after the closing, as in the Ver.2 doc.

Graded anonymously to a published standard, with every grade explained and every card housed. All sports and all TCG.
